issues.title: Lower the Cost of Living
issues.text: Taryn will pursue coordinated housing and transportation strategies that reduce everyday costs, expand diverse housing options, and ensure growth happens in the right places to support long-term affordability.

issues.title: Build Real Transportation Options
issues.text: Taryn will advocate for meaningful transit, safer streets, and walkable communities to lower transportation costs, reduce congestion, and improve daily quality of life across Tampa’s neighborhoods.

issues.title: Support Local Businesses
issues.text: Taryn will streamline permitting, improve transparency, and expand technical support so small businesses can open faster, grow sustainably, and continue to strengthen Tampa’s local economy.

issues.title: Plan a Resilient Tampa
issues.text: Taryn will advance data-driven planning that addresses climate risk, flood resilience, and infrastructure needs while protecting neighborhood character and keeping community voices central in decision-making.

issues.title: Advance Educational Partnerships
issues.text: Taryn will strengthen partnerships with local schools, colleges, and training programs to support workforce development, neighborhood stability, and expanded opportunities for residents across Tampa.

issues.title: Engage the Community
issues.text: Taryn will work directly with residents, business owners, and community leaders to co-create programs that reflect real needs, maximize impact, and ensure policies are shaped by the people they serve.
